purpose: Public-safe job object registry for GitHub Actions CV package builds. These objects are safe rendering hints only; they do not import private job packets or private evidence.

neutral.label: Neutral public CV package
neutral.profile_emphasis: Public-health, applied-economics, health-data-science, reproducible research, and public-service trajectory.
neutral.tailoring_notes: Use the standard public package without role-specific reframing.

harvard-chan-director-data-analytics.label: Harvard Chan - Director of Data and Analytics
harvard-chan-director-data-analytics.profile_emphasis: Longitudinal analytics, public-health research data, reproducible documentation, manuscript support, and public-use data readiness.
harvard-chan-director-data-analytics.tailoring_notes: Emphasize research-data judgment and public-health analytics. Keep AI and scanner language secondary and support-oriented.
exclusions: SAS or Stata production ownership unless separately verified

indeed-data-scientist-iii.label: Indeed - Data Scientist III
indeed-data-scientist-iii.role_family: commercial data science and applied analytics
indeed-data-scientist-iii.profile_emphasis: Applied quantitative reasoning, reproducible analytics, evidence review, and careful translation of data into decision-ready outputs.
indeed-data-scientist-iii.tailoring_notes: Emphasize applied analytics and evidence discipline. Avoid implying direct ownership of large-scale commercial product experimentation unless separately verified.

rockland-trust-data-architect.label: Rockland Trust - Data Architect
rockland-trust-data-architect.profile_emphasis: Structured documentation, data governance, source control, audit discipline, and careful systems thinking.
rockland-trust-data-architect.tailoring_notes: Emphasize governance, documentation, and systems reasoning. Keep architecture claims bounded to evidenced workflow and data-system design.

navsea-sstm-data-science.label: NAVSEA - SSTM Data Science
navsea-sstm-data-science.role_family: defense-adjacent data science and analytical engineering
navsea-sstm-data-science.profile_emphasis: Public service, mission-data discipline, analytical documentation, reproducible methods, and careful evidence handling.
navsea-sstm-data-science.tailoring_notes: Use conservative historical service language and avoid sensitive operational detail.

valo-health-staff-data-scientist.label: Valo Health - Staff Data Scientist
valo-health-staff-data-scientist.role_family: health data science and epidemiology-adjacent ML
valo-health-staff-data-scientist.profile_emphasis: Health data science, public-health methods, reproducible analytics, model-evaluation literacy, and careful evidence translation.
valo-health-staff-data-scientist.tailoring_notes: Emphasize health-data and evaluation judgment. Keep ML ownership claims bounded where production deployment evidence is not public.
exclusions: private health data handling claims without source support

unh-adjunct-homeland-security.label: UNH - Adjunct Faculty, Homeland Security
unh-adjunct-homeland-security.role_family: homeland security, cybersecurity, and public/private risk instruction
unh-adjunct-homeland-security.profile_emphasis: Public-safe teaching fit across cybersecurity, information assurance, enterprise risk, emergency management, public-health systems, technical infrastructure literacy, and evidence discipline.
unh-adjunct-homeland-security.tailoring_notes: Use public-safe language only. Emphasize teaching readiness, systems thinking, legal and ethical judgment, and public/private risk. Keep sharper private application wording in Applications-Jobs.
